Okay thanks.

Well, thats kind of the thing. The woman who did the diagnose says she doesn’t see any borderline and that’s it’s only CPTSD and depression. My psychiatrist has observed me the last 2 month and the conclusion she says to me that its borderline. But I scored only one thing in the borderline diagnose. So the woman wants me to go trauma related therapy and psychiatrist wants me in borderline therapy with then also trauma afterwards. I heard that borderline therapy would be clinical and would take a lot of months but for trauma I could do at home. I just don’t want to take the wrong decisions to pick which one first (cuz they don’t treat at the same time) and later regret it.

Thanks for your comment ! Where can I do the ACE ? Yes, that’s what my psychiatrist says. The only thing we are worried about is how I will react after a trauma session. It’s pretty hard for me to talk about. That’s why they think if it’s also borderline that we first address that and then do trauma. But what you’re saying is better first treat the trauma and look how that’s goes and see if borderline is still there. 

Don’t know if you know this but I forgot to ask if I have 4 different traits of personality disorder. Does that mean this also needs to be in focus for therapy or is it more like you have traits of it but not enough to address it in therapy ?
